scene_analysis.scene_overview: A narrow street in a residential area with tall buildings on both sides. The street is paved with gray concrete pavers and has a few pedestrians and vehicles passing by. There are several buildings lining the street, including a tan-colored building with a balcony and a white van parked in front of it. A man wearing a black jacket and khaki pants walks his dog along the sidewalk.
